summary: POST-certified patrol officer with 10 years of continuous municipal law-enforcement experience, including emergency response, criminal enforcement, and community relations in a mid-sized jurisdiction. Recognized for accurate incident documentation, sound legal charging decisions, and calm first-aid response under pressure.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol) — POST Certified
bullets: Patrol assigned sector by vehicle and on foot, maintaining order and responding to emergency calls for service; consistently among the top responders with an average 8-minute response time on priority-one calls.
Identify, pursue, and arrest suspects and perpetrators of criminal acts, completing 60+ custodial arrests over the past two years with a 94% case-filing acceptance rate.
Verify that proper legal charges are made against law offenders by reviewing incident facts against applicable statutes before presenting cases to the district attorney.
Render first aid to accident survivors and injured persons, including CPR and Stop the Bleed application, stabilizing 20+ individuals prior to EMS arrival.
Record facts and prepare detailed incident reports documenting observations, statements, and evidence; reports are routinely cited as model documentation during shift briefings.
Investigate illegal and suspicious activities, conducting field interviews, canvassing, and evidence collection for burglary, assault, and narcotics cases.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
bullets: Drove patrol vehicles across designated areas to detect law violators, issuing 1,400+ traffic citations and making 45 DUI arrests over three years.
Enforced motor vehicle and criminal laws while promoting good community relations through foot patrols, business checks, and neighborhood meetings.
Responded to domestic disturbance, alarm, and accident calls, de-escalating confrontations and connecting affected residents with victim-services resources.
Documented incidents and reviewed facts to determine whether criminal acts or statute violations occurred, referring cases to detectives when warranted.
Provided first-aid response to accident survivors and other persons requiring physical injury care, coordinating with fire and EMS units on scene.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
bullets: Maintained public safety by patrolling high-crime areas, responding to emergencies, and protecting people and property throughout the assigned district.
Served as initial responder on burglary, theft, and assault calls; gathered statements and physical evidence supporting 200+ closed cases during tenure.
Identified and pursued suspects, executing traffic stops and foot pursuits resulting in 30+ arrests for felony and misdemeanor offenses.
Prepared reports documenting incident facts and legal charge verifications, ensuring timely submission within the shift-end deadline.
Completed crisis-intervention and defensive tactics training, applying verbal de-escalation techniques on 150+ mental-health-related calls.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
bullets: Completed field-training program and assumed solo patrol duties, enforcing traffic and criminal laws within an urban beat.
Responded to emergency calls for service, rendering first aid to accident survivors and other injured persons ahead of medical transport.
Recorded incident facts and prepared daily activity and arrest reports reviewed by supervisory staff.
Supported community-relations events and directed traffic at collisions and public gatherings.
